_note: Places with several courses that each have their own data folder (a shared folder, like East Potomac's, sets its group in pipeline s10). course-lists.mjs puts each listed course in the group; a course whose own course.json already has a group keeps it, so a place can be part shared folder, part own folders (the Olympic Club) when the key is the shared folder's id. keepNames: the courses keep their full names inside the group (Bandon Trails, not Trails).

bandon_resort.name: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort
bandon_resort.why: developer, 2026-10-27: all the Bandon courses under one umbrella like East Potomac, Silvies Valley and Pumpkin Ridge

olympic_club.name: The Olympic Club
olympic_club.why: developer, 2026-11-13: the Olympic Club should be one place with its courses under it, like Pumpkin Ridge, Bandon and the Reserve. The Lake has its group from data/olympic_club (s10); the Cliffs has its own folder and joins it here.
